entities.summary: The cabinet of Miloš Vučević was formed on 2 May 2024, following the latter's election as Prime Minister of Serbia by the National Assembly on the same day. It succeeded the third cabinet of Ana Brnabić and was the incumbent government of Serbia from 2 May 2024 to 16 April 2025.
